description: ⚠️ Replaces the table's ENTIRE column schema with the list given — columns not included are removed. This is the only way to correct a column type a scanner inferred wrongly. Read the current schema first with ncloud_datacatalog_get_table_schema.

columns.description: Full replacement column list, in the desired column order

type.description: Column data type (e.g. string, int, bigint, double, boolean, timestamp)

typeValue.description: Detailed definition for a complex type (array, struct, map)

name: ncloud_datacatalog_update_table_schema
